verdict.rationale: The evidence confirms MailerLite has its own automations that fire on events without a human present: abandoned-cart automations triggered via the API, and emails sent automatically on booking. Automations can also be managed from the official CLI. There is no first-party description of the automation builder itself, its triggers, steps or conditions, or how it runs in the background, so only the existence and triggering of automations is evidenced. Missing for 10: documentation of the automation workflow builder and its trigger/condition/delay options, explicit confirmation of continuous background execution, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: manage subscribers, campaigns, automations, and more from your terminal
